msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a woman). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. REGLA B: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia kisco-calzados-02.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing black leather mid-calf cowboy boots with stitching, with cream trousers from the reference, walking at the Plaza del Arenal in Jerez de la Frontera, Spain, with palm trees, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia kisco-calzados-07.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Footwear e-commerce photo of black croc-effect leather ankle boots with a slim heel and a pointed toe from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEE9E2) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia kisco-calzados-13.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Footwear e-commerce photo of black and brown Mary Jane ballet flat shoes with a buckle strap from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEE9E2) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia kisco-calzados-22.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Footwear e-commerce photo of brown suede tasselled loafers from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEE9E2) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia kisco-calzados-16.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Footwear e-commerce photo of brown velvet slingback kitten heel shoes with a bow from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEE9E2) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail.
